content: {"like":["The first hour was excellent and kept my attention.","Edward Yang knows how to show his characters' emotions pictorially.","City and traffic shots of Taipei are abundantly shown moving rapidly and constantly in the background and foreground while the characters seem in stasis.","Corporate images have a Leviathan-like presence taking over the city and engulfing the people (a gigantic Fuji Billboard is most prominent)."],"dislike":["After the first hour, the film started to feel repetitive and drawn out.","Its gloomy tone also began to get on my nerves.","Lack of chemistry between the couple, Chin and Lung.","Lung didn't seem to care much about Chin, being absorbed in a baseball game on TV.","Chin didn't seem attached to Lung.","Chin had a fling with her co-worker, suggesting she wasn't committed to Lung.","Relationships start with practically zero chemistry, leaving little to fall from."]}
